title: A dedicated lens should offer itself where its context is (2026-11-03)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
I think that we can make the ability to switch lenses more obvious. 
If we have got a dedicated editor/lens for the current context, can we present it as a more obvious, contextually relavant option?

sections.name: source
sections.label: Source
sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-11-03; recorded verbatim (after srs-web began opening repositories in Read by default, srs-web#670, and the way back to the explorer and editors was only under Go > Explorer).
